lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man maarai apunaa mukatee kaa dar paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||
They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad rakhai ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sach rate sadaa bairaagee haumai maar milaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||
Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspires us to receive it.
The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thake chauthe pad kee saar na paavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||
The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan raate gur sabad ra(n)gaae ||
lines.translation: Only those who are steeped in the Word of the Guru's Shabad are so imbued with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g chaRiaa at apaaraa har ras ras gun gaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Imbued with the most beautiful color of the Lord's Love, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, with great pleasure and joy. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ridh sidh sach sa(n)jam soee ||
lines.translation: To the Gurmukh, the True Lord is wealth, miraculous spiritual powers and strict self-discipline.
Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh kaar sach kamaavahi sache sach samaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh practices Truth, and is absorbed in the Truest of the True. ||7||
The Gurmukh realizes that the Lord alone creates, and having created, He destroys.
To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh naam dhiaae naame naam samaavaniaa ||8||12||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; through the Naam, they merge in the Naam. ||8||12||13||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Creation and destruction happen through the Word of the Shabad.
Through the Shabad, creation happens again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh varatai sabh aape sachaa guramukh upaai samaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh knows that the True Lord is all-pervading. The Gurmukh understands creation and merger. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gur pooraa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te saat bhagat kare din raatee gun kahi gunee samaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: From the Guru comes peace and tranquility; worship Him with devotion, day and night. Chanting His Glorious Praises, merge into the Glorious Lord. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh sees the Lord on the earth, and the Gurmukh sees Him in the water.
The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so niguraa jo mar mar ja(n)mai nigure aavan jaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: One who has no Guru, dies over and over again, only to be re-born. One who has no Guru continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||2||
The One Creator has set this play in motion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa sareerai vich sabh kichh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਮਹਲੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabad bhed koee mahal paae mahale mahal bulaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||
True is the Banker, and true are His traders.
They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sach vihaajhahi sach kamaavahi sacho sach kamaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੋ ਵਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin raasee ko vath kiu paae ||
lines.translation: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?
The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin raasee sabh khaalee chale khaalee jaai dukh paavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they suffer in pain. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sach vana(n)jahi gur sabad piaare ||
lines.translation: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.
They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aae se paravaan hoe mil preetam sukh paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||
Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.
The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jithai vath hovai tithahu koi na paavai manamukh bharam bhulaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||
He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.
The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੩॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee aape sun sun dhiaavaniaa ||8||13||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again and again, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings.
